name: pinprompt
description: Click any element on a page, say what to change, and copy a clean Markdown prompt for Claude, ChatGPT or any AI.

scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npx --yes web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npx --yes web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest --filename pinprompt-firefox-{version}.zip
scripts.package: npm run package:chrome && npm run package:firefox
